risk_assessment.summary: Low severity issues detected. Review recommendations for security improvements.

findings.title: Algorithm 'HS256' Not in Allowed Algorithm List
findings.impact: Using non-whitelisted algorithms may indicate misconfiguration or an attempt to exploit algorithm confusion vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Configure your JWT library to explicitly whitelist allowed algorithms. Never derive the algorithm from the token header.

findings.title: Token Expiration: Valid
findings.recommendation: Monitor token lifetime to ensure it aligns with policy.

findings.title: Signature Verification: VALID (HS256)
findings.evidence: Algorithm: HS256 | HMAC signature verified successfully using the provided secret.
findings.impact: Token signature is cryptographically valid with the provided key.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the signing secret is rotated regularly and stored securely.
